scope: Every Composer production/development dependency, every npm production/development/optional lock entry, and the pinned native source closure. OS packages and workflow actions remain separately inventoried by Syft; this policy makes no licence claim for those components.

rules.compoundExpression: deny pending an explicit policy entry

obligations.all: Preserve upstream licence, copyright and notice files. Publish exact source distribution URLs and source references with the SBOM. No vendor modifications are permitted.
obligations.MPL-2.0: Retain file-level notices and provide the exact corresponding upstream source distribution for bundled browser modules; App does not modify these upstream files.
obligations.PHP-3.01: Retain the PHP notice and attribution; do not imply endorsement or rename the application as PHP.
